columns.name: sha
columns.meaning: commit SHA

columns.name: authored_at
columns.meaning: UTC, %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ

columns.name: year
columns.meaning: from authored_at

columns.name: split
columns.meaning: train, val, test by year; none after the test year or after follow_up_end

columns.name: label
columns.meaning: 1 if a fix commit authored within window_days after this one blames it (bug_inducing)

columns.name: la
columns.meaning: lines added (binary files count 0)

columns.name: ld
columns.meaning: lines deleted (binary files count 0)

columns.name: nf
columns.meaning: files touched

columns.name: nd
columns.meaning: directories touched

columns.name: ns
columns.meaning: top-level directories touched

columns.name: entropy
columns.meaning: Shannon entropy (bits) of changed lines across files

columns.name: ndev
columns.meaning: distinct earlier authors (merged persons) on these files

columns.name: age
columns.meaning: mean days since these files last changed; 0 when none changed before

columns.name: nuc
columns.meaning: distinct earlier commits on these files

columns.name: exp
columns.meaning: the author's earlier commits (merged person)

columns.name: sexp
columns.meaning: the author's earlier commits in this commit's module

columns.name: prior_bug_fixes
columns.meaning: fix commits on these files in the prior_fix_days before this commit

columns.name: fix
columns.meaning: 1 if a linked ticket's effective_type is Bug

columns.name: has_ticket
columns.meaning: 1 if the commit carries a ticket key that exists in the tracker

columns.name: ticket_type
columns.meaning: the linked ticket's effective_type (smallest key), or none

columns.name: is_minor
columns.meaning: subject starts with [MINOR], any case

columns.name: module
columns.meaning: slice: top-level directory with the most changed lines; inside sql/, the second level

columns.name: component
columns.meaning: slice: the linked ticket's first Jira component (smallest key), or none

columns.name: exp_bucket
columns.meaning: slice: 0, 1, 2-10, >10 earlier commits

columns.name: size_bucket
columns.meaning: slice: la + ld by quartile on train, Q1 to Q4
